{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for missing values in key columns
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check unique values in customer_segment
segment_counts = sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts()

# Check if there are any refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'refunded']

# Print the results
missing_values, segment_counts, refunded_orders.shape"}
